**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause**
Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak) changed `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Applied at 02:13:41 UTC. Requests started grabbing a connection per request instead of sharing the pool, and the pool (size 20) ran out.

**Impact window**
First 503 at 02:14:18 UTC on 2026-03-14. Still failing at the end of the log, 03:59:27 UTC. No recovery seen yet. Every failing service call gets `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, and the wait queue keeps growing.

**Scope**
Gateway only. Workers stayed healthy the whole time, no pool errors there.

**Rollback**
Roll back `dep-4471`. Set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`.
